text:
Ivy: Tiny poll: what should we name the new office coffee/order slack bot? quick reactions please! :coffee:
Noah: Options to get the ball rolling: Moka, BrewBot, Baristabot, or Perk?
Ivy: Vote with emoji: :one: Moka, :two: BrewBot, :three: Baristabot, :four: Perk. Or toss in wildcards.
ops-bot: Poll started: 1) Moka 2) BrewBot 3) Baristabot 4) Perk — react to cast vote. I will post interim results in 30m.
Priya: :two: BrewBot — short and clear.
Ethan: :three: Baristabot feels delightfully earnest.
Noah: :one: Moka for me. Classic.
Ivy: Throwaway suggestion: "Bean There" as a cheeky two-word name?
Priya: Bean There is peak pun energy. 
Ethan: please no puns we will hear them forever.
Noah: I accept the puns if they come with donuts.
ops-bot: Interim tally — Moka: 1, BrewBot: 1, Baristabot: 1, Perk: 0. Still open.
Ivy: Also thinking about micro-UX: if BrewBot wins it posts a small coffee cup emoji on orders, Baristabot could post a latte art GIF.
Priya: Good point. UX vibes could sway me.
Ethan: Whoever loses has to bring the first round of coffee? Stakes.
Noah: Deal. If Moka wins I9ll bring croissants.
Ivy: Closing poll in 30m. Thanks y9all.
ops-bot: Poll closed. Final tally: Moka 2, BrewBot 1, Baristabot 1, Perk 0. Winner: Moka.
Ivy: Moka it is. Noah — croissants incoming. Thanks everyone!
Noah: On it. ETA 9:30 tomorrow.
Priya: Love it. New handle will be @moka soon :tada:
